en: When the President vetoes a proposed law, Congress can override it only if two-thirds of both houses vote to approve it again.
Filipinos display the blue field of the national flag on top during peace, but flip it to the red field on top during war.
The ratification of the Malolos Constitution established the First Philippine Republic by creating a separate legislative branch to check the power of the President.
Ifugao farmers build stone-walled terraces along mountain contours to catch rainwater, which flows downward through a traditional irrigation system to water the rice paddies.
Dr. Fe del Mundo created a makeshift bamboo incubator that uses a hot water bottle to maintain a constant temperature for premature babies without electricity.
Dancers perform the Sinulog step by moving two steps forward and one step backward to mimic the natural flowing current of water.
The ancient Baybayin script writes syllables instead of single letters, requiring a small mark called a kudlit above or below a character to change its vowel sound.
Jose Rizal wrote Noli Me Tangere to expose the abuses of Spanish friars, which awakened Filipino nationalism and inspired the Katipunan to start the revolution.
The Office of the Ombudsman investigates complaints against government officials, and if it finds probable cause, it files the criminal cases in the Sandiganbayan court.
The tradition of Bayanihan works by having an entire community physically carry a family's traditional nipa hut to relocate it to a new site.
Dr. Julian Banzon developed a chemical process using solvent extraction to efficiently separate coconut oil from copra, providing a local alternative to imported fuels.
The Barangay Justice System resolves minor neighborhood disputes by requiring complainants to undergo mediation by the Lupon Tagapamayapa before they are allowed to file a court case.
